name_zh: Alpha158 前4期成交量/当前成交量
formula_zh: 前4期成交量 / (当前成交量 + 1e-12)
intuition_en: Alpha158 lagged volume ratio over a 5-bar window. It compares prior volume with current volume to diagnose short-horizon volume expansion or fade.
intuition_zh: Alpha158滞后成交量比率，使用5根K线窗口，将前期成交量与当前成交量比较，用于诊断短周期成交量扩张或衰退。
expected_direction_explanation_en: Direction is conditional: lagged/current volume can mark fading attention, fresh participation, stress selling, or redundant liquidity context.
expected_direction_explanation_zh: 方向为条件式：滞后/当前成交量可能表示关注度衰退、新资金参与、压力抛售，或仅提供冗余流动性背景。
known_limitations_en: Raw lagged volume ratio; can be unstable when current volume is tiny and may overlap with volume z-score/liquidity diagnostics.
known_limitations_zh: 原始滞后成交量比率；当前成交量很小时可能不稳定，并可能与成交量Z分数/流动性诊断重叠。
horizon_notes_en: Lookback window: 5 bars. Evaluation covers 1h/4h/24h/72h horizons.
horizon_notes_zh: 回溯窗口：5根K线。评价覆盖1h/4h/24h/72h视野。
status_explanation_en: Status: DIAGNOSTIC_PROBE. Diagnostic probe — not yet promoted to active signal.
